verdict.rationale: The docs describe two update paths. One is an explicit `npx skills update` command for the copied, editable install. The other is a Claude Code official-marketplace plugin that installs a read-only bundle that 'updates when I ship' and stays 'always-current'. Either way, users get fixes without reinstalling from scratch. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the update command and plugin auto-update work as described, and detailed docs on update behavior (e.g., how local edits are handled during `npx skills update`, or versioning/changelog).
